JUICE. A player taking the ball. Tiny - a scuff of boot on leather, nothing more. It plays several times a second while the party runs, so anything with a tail turns into a drone. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty
JUICE. A player striking the ball on the run. Short, dry, a little harder than ball_tap. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty

JUICE. An ordinary hit landing on an enemy. The workhorse - you will hear this more than any other sound in the game, so keep it short and unmemorable. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty

JUICE. A big hit landing. Lower and fuller than hit_soft. It plays ON TOP of hit_soft rather than instead of it, so it should sit underneath rather than compete. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty
JUICE. An enemy finished off. A short collapse - the release at the end of a fight. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty

JUICE. One of yours running out of stamina and going down on the grass. Heavier and slower than player_hurt - this one is final for the fight. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty
JUICE. An item mending somebody. Warm and short. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty

JUICE. A combo completing in the build-up window. A bright little confirmation - it is the sound of the move working. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty

JUICE. An enemy gaining its buff while you build your move. Should feel like a clock ticking, not like an attack. Named by the Sound column of Juice.csv rather than fired by an event - that is why the When column is empty
